rules.rule: Identification statement: state 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases' clearly and prominently on the site.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure strip under the masthead and in the footer of every page, using the exact statement.

rules.rule: Violating §5 is a material breach (termination and forfeited commissions).
rules.site_implementation: Statement is generated from one template on every page so it cannot drift between pages.

rules.rule: Special Links must include the Associates ID as a parameter in the URL of each link to an Amazon Site.
rules.site_implementation: Supplied short links kept as-is. Observed redirect targets do not show a tag parameter. Not claimed valid. Test pending (FLG-02, FLG-04).

rules.rule: Prices and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes via PA-API / Creators API.
rules.site_implementation: No prices or availability published. Price fields are blank and marked.

rules.rule: Star ratings and customer reviews may be displayed only via Creators API / PA-API.
rules.site_implementation: No ratings or review counts published.

rules.rule: Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality (unless Amazon agrees).
rules.site_implementation: No price tracking. Brief's 'analyzes pricing' step is listed as a decision (Suggestions D2).

rules.rule: Do not use a link shortening service in a way that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
rules.site_implementation: Short links are displayed with the text 'Amazon' and the product title beside them. Whether the supplied short links meet §6(w) is not determined. Not claimed invalid (FLG-03).

rules.rule: Do not cloak, hide, spoof or obscure the Site URL containing Special Links.
rules.site_implementation: No redirect layer, no link cloaking. Outbound links point directly to the supplied URLs.

rules.rule: No incentive for clicks, and no encouragement of artificial clicks.
rules.site_implementation: Copy contains no click prompts, rewards or discounts.

rules.rule: No sub-tag may be tied to a specific end user.
rules.site_implementation: No per-user tracking. Click counting (D3) must be aggregate only.

rules.rule: Disclosure must be clear and conspicuous, placed with the endorsement, and not only on an About page.
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure strip sits directly under the masthead on each page (above the fold), and the same statement is in the footer.

rules.rule: Material connection (including commission income) must be disclosed (16 CFR 255.5 — section title only verified).
rules.site_implementation: Disclosure states that the site may earn commission on qualifying purchases.
rules.status: Implemented — legal wording not reviewed by counsel

rules.site_implementation: Every outbound product link carries rel="sponsored noopener" (checked by scripts/check_site.py).

rules.rule: Program Content (text, images, widgets) may not be altered except resizing images or truncating text.
rules.site_implementation: No Amazon images were copied or scraped. Product text is limited to the listing title and observed ASIN.

rules.rule: Special Links must link to Products; product-list pages need original content on your site.
rules.site_implementation: Each link goes to one product detail page (dp/ASIN), not a search results or list page.

rules.rule: Special Links may not be used in print, ebooks, mailings or orally; email/SMS only when opted in.
rules.site_implementation: Web-only. No email or print distribution.

rules.rule: Do not display Amazon-marked names in site domains, subdomains, tags or identifiers.
rules.site_implementation: Site name is 'Kitchen Picks'. Repository name WinB is unchanged.

rules.rule: Static hosting publishes from a branch and a /docs folder.
rules.source_detail: GitHub Docs — publishing from a branch
rules.site_implementation: Pages source is main branch, /docs folder.
